title: Apexspace hero
description: A window-tall hero over a full-bleed film dimmed by a 50% wash. A light uppercase headline (42 → 72px) sits top-left just under the bar; a short paragraph and a black mono button sit in a 480px right column on desktop and stack under the headline on phones.
notes: 100svh tall; the content leaves 65px at the top for apexspace-header, which overlaps it
media fills the section like object-fit: cover; when empty a muted placeholder shows
the text sits on a background-coloured wash, so it keeps contrast in light and dark themes
